events.title: The Free Demo of Curse Of The Abandoned Floor Is Coming Soon!
events.summary: Hello everyone! We are Lakecho Studio, the development team behind Curse Of The Abandoned Floor. We are excited to announce that the free Demo of our first-person psychological horror game, Curse Of The Abandoned Floor, will launch on Steam on July 27, 2026, at 3:00 PM Beijing Time (UTC+8). This is our studio’s first game and a horror experience into which we have poured a great deal of time, effort, and passion.
